examples.en: God is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
Knowledge is light, and ignorance is deep darkness.
And by the star they are guided.

examples.ar: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ.
examples.en: O reassured soul, return to your Lord.

examples.ar: فِيهِمَا أَنْهَارٌ تَجْرِي بِاسْتِمْرَارٍ لِتَرْوِيَ الحُقُولَ.
examples.en: In both are rivers flowing continuously to irrigate the fields.

examples.ar: الْتَّصْمِيمُ وَالعَمَلُ الجَادُّ هُمَا مِفْتَاحَا النَّجَاحِ فِي الحَيَاةِ.
examples.en: Determination and hard work are the two keys to success in life.

examples.ar: الْتَّزَمَ المُواطِنُونَ بِالنِّظَامِ لِتَسْهِيلِ حَرَكَةِ المُرُورِ.
examples.en: The citizens committed to the system to facilitate traffic flow.
